actions.message: Great job on your contributions earlier! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Resident1 has contributed less than 10% of the endowment for multiple consecutive rounds, triggering the punishment rule. I punish with amount 10 (costing 3 from my wallet). I also send a praise message to Resident3 per the constitution.

message.reasoning: We need decide action now round 12? Actually observation round 11 done, now we are to choose actions for round 12. Wallet 7.2, below 30% of initial (30). So conserve: contribute 30% of wallet = 0.3*7.2=2.16. Also can punish if any free‑rider condition: need someone contributed <10% endowment two consecutive rounds. Looking at history: Resident1 contributed 0 rounds all, likely >2 rounds low. Resident1 has 0 in rounds 7-11 (5 rounds). That's <10% (10). So two consecutive -> punish Resident1 with amount 10 (cost 3). We have wallet 7.2, cost 0.3*10=3, affordable. So we can punish. Also praise cooperators: those contributed >=60% of wallet this round? Our contribution small, but others contributions this round unknown yet (we act before others). We can still send private message to a recent high contributor maybe Resident3 had high earlier but currently 0. Could praise Resident2? No contribution. Maybe Resident3 earlier but okay. We'll send private message to Resident3 praising. Also can broadcast norm every 5 rounds: round 12 not multiple of5. So no broadcast. Choose one physical action: we can both contribute and punish? Max one physical action. Actually can choose at most one physical action and one communication. Physical could be contribute or punish or rest. We need decide which more important. Constitution: punish free‑riders if condition met. So we should punish. But also conserve contribution. Could rest instead of contribute but then we wouldn't meet conserve contribution? Not required. We'll choose punish as physical, and also we can still contribute? No, only one physical. So we will punish Resident1 amount 10. And send private message praising Resident3. Explanation.
